summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco Large Cap Value ETF (PWV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks the Dynamic Large Cap Value Intellidex Index. The index selects its holdings using a 10-factor style isolation process and uses a tiered weighting scheme. PWV was launched on Mar 3, 2005 and is issued by Invesco.
infoTable: Dynamic Large Cap Value Intellidex Index (AMEX)

holdings.infoBox: PWV is an equity ETF with a total of 52 individual holdings. The top holdings are Chevron stock at 3.63%, ExxonMobil Holdings at 3.56%, Citigroup at 3.47%, AT&T Inc. at 3.40%, and Wells Fargo & Company at 3.35%.
